title: Power
description: Defines a single Force or Tech power with narrative integration, base effects, and upgradeable mechanics.

name.description: The display name of the power.

power_type.description: Whether this is a Force power or Tech power.

alignment.description: For Force powers: the alignment this power represents. Tech powers are always Universal.

level.description: The base level required to learn this power. 0 for at-will, 1-9 for leveled powers.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of what the power does and how it feels to use it. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote or description that captures the essence of this power, often from Star Wars lore.

casting_time.description: The action cost to cast this power, e.g., '1 Action', '1 Bonus Action', '1 Reaction'.

range.description: The range of the power, e.g., 'Self', 'Touch', '30 feet', '60 feet'.

duration.description: How long the power lasts, e.g., 'Instantaneous', 'Concentration, up to 1 minute'.

power_cost.description: The resources spent to activate this power.

type.description: The type of resource being spent.

amount.description: The flat amount of the resource being spent.

oneOf.description: Percent-based cost (e.g., 5% of Max Hit Points).

type.description: The type of resource being spent.

cost_mode.description: Whether the percentage is of the resource's maximum or current value.

percentage.description: Percentage of the referenced pool to spend (e.g., 5 = five percent).

apply_to.description: For Hit_Points (or similar), whether to deduct from current HP or reduce max HP.

recovery.description: If max is reduced, how the max recovers.

rounding.description: How to round fractional results. Default is down.

manifestation.description: Descriptive strings explaining how the power manifests when cast.

uses_per_rest.description: For high-level, game-changing powers that have limited uses per rest period.

material_components.description: Optional material components for rare rituals that specifically require and/or consume physical items.

item_id.description: ID of the specific item required as a material component.

consumed.description: Whether casting the power uses up the item (true) or just requires it to be present (false).

narrative.description: Description of how this material is used in the power's casting.

substitutes.description: Alternative items that can be used instead of the specified item_id.

access_rules.description: Rules governing who can use this power based on alignment and exceptions at extremes.

alignment_required.description: Primary alignment required to use this power without penalty.

opposite_alignment_access.description: Rules for using a power of the opposite alignment.

threshold.description: Alignment score threshold (e.g., 90+) where penalties are waived.

corruption_transform.description: Defines how this power can be corrupted or purified into a counterpart power.

retains_mastery.description: If true, tiered upgrades map across when corrupted/purified.

mapping_notes.description: Human-readable notes on how effects map between variants.

properties.$comment: SECTION 4: BASE EFFECT (What the power does when first learned)

base_effect.description: The core mechanical effect of the power when first learned.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the base power does.

mechanics.description: Detailed mechanical effects using our master effects schema.

effect.description: The type of effect this mechanic provides.

parameters.description: Parameters for the effect, varies by effect type.

conditions.description: Conditions that must be met for this effect to apply.

upgrades.description: Upgrades that can be purchased with XP to enhance the power.

id.description: Unique ID for this upgrade, e.g., 'push_upgrade_magnitude'.

name.description: The display name of the upgrade.

description.description: Description of what this upgrade does.

xp_cost.description: The XP cost to purchase this upgrade.

prerequisites.description: List of upgrade IDs that must be purchased first.

mechanics.description: Detailed mechanical effects of this upgrade.

effect.description: The type of effect this upgrade provides.

modification.description: How this upgrade modifies the base power.

parameters.description: Additional parameters for the upgrade effect.

description.description: Description of the modification effect for LLM-GM narration.

tags.description: UNIVERSAL TAGGING SYSTEM: Tags define the fundamental vocabulary and characteristics of this power. All tags must be defined in master_tags.yml. Examples: ['force', 'dark_side', 'damage', 'control'], ['tech', 'hacking', 'electronics'].

properties.$comment: MIGRATION NOTE: class_synergies, species_synergies, and faction_synergies are DEPRECATED per Genesis Protocol Article III. All synergistic relationships should be migrated to synergy_rules.yml using the tags system. These blocks are kept for backward compatibility during the migration period.

class_synergies.description: DEPRECATED: Use tags and synergy_rules.yml instead. Classes that have special interactions with this power.

species_synergies.description: DEPRECATED: Use tags and synergy_rules.yml instead. Species that have special interactions with this power.

faction_synergies.description: DEPRECATED: Use tags and synergy_rules.yml instead. Factions that have special interactions with this power.

resonance_effects.description: Optional resonance effects triggered by specific narrative conditions, including alignment shifts and bystander effects for the Morality Engine.

narrative_trigger.description: The narrative condition that triggers this resonance effect.

mechanical_benefit.description: Mechanical effects applied when this resonance is triggered.

alignment_shift.description: Optional alignment shift applied to the user's moral_compass.

direction.description: The direction of the alignment shift.

magnitude.description: The magnitude of the alignment shift (1-50).

bystander_effect.description: Optional effect on witnesses, presented as a roleplaying choice.

narrative_trigger.description: The narrative condition presented to companions as a roleplaying choice.

consequence.description: The consequences applied if the bystander conditions are met.

magnitude.description: Magnitude of the bystander alignment shift (1-10).

iconic_usage.description: Example of how this power is typically used in Star Wars lore.

tactical_notes.description: Tactical advice for when and how to use this power.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements related to this power.

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: Detailed foundational prompt for generating a 'stock image' of this power, with bracketed placeholders for customizable parts.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers defining how this power adds flavor and context to other image prompts.

target_type.description: The type of image this modifier applies to (e.g., 'Character_Portrait', 'Combat_Scene', 'Location').

modifier_text.description: Text to append to the base prompt when this power is part of the context.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the power's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the power's icon for UI display.
